venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Highs in the low 90s, lows in the 70s
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 8/26 (MOD: MKZ/JK)** Beat target ($1,657 vs $1,497). Late start to the night; only one Meal Deal sold. MKZ filled in as opener — steady guest flow and sales with no big pop or lull, slowing around 9-10pm before a small last-call pop of locals and regulars. Two batches made prepping for the weekend. APD visited to check permits/licenses: business license updated on the spot, but the State Alcohol Permit must be displayed alongside the City permit, and the Food Permit expires 9/1 — no citations, just instructions. Filtered water pump froze again at end of night; turned off to defrost overnight and must be restarted before tomorrow's service. 86 Banhez Pineapple (seasonal; United sourcing bottles). Favorite moment: regular Billy stopping in twice.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 8/26 (MOD: KK & MD / Chef JMS)** Beat target ($1,384 vs $1,211). Decent Wednesday — sleepy start, found the groove ~8:15pm with peak volume 9-10pm. Lower food sales ($44) and check averages than recent trend; most guests grabbing a round after dinner or popping by. Extra sidework and cleaning projects completed; team prepped to finish the week strong. Comps $54.85 / 3.96% (Manager, DNL, F&F, Industry, Neuhoff Employee). Low: Diet Coke. Favorite moment: celebrating a guest's 21st birthday with his friends and family.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 8/26 (AM: Maggie S & Josh / PM: Maggie H & Chef Rachel)** Just under target ($9,004 vs $9,648). Torrential downpour flooded The Garden and forced an early shutdown ($636 Garden/6A sales before closing; cushion covers left off to dry). Lobby stayed steady through the rain — 'Wednesday night type-shi.' AM cafe did $1,115 (bank $10 short; declared tips adjusted from $20 to $10 to balance; cold brew ready 8am; matcha order needed ASAP). Kitchen: Ayu killing sauté; decent 911 list for tomorrow (chantilly, chicken thigh, scallop, burger meat, walnut pesto, onion jam, olives); low on tomato water, burger portions, rabbit; nothing 86'd. Maintenance: Garden bar top chipping (sharp) — photos taken, added to maintenance app.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 8/26 (MOD: Kyler & Steves)** Under target ($3,753 vs $4,885). Slower Wednesday that allowed guests to linger — lots of birthdays and first-timers. Full at 7:30pm, a void 8:30-9pm revived by a reservation wave to 2/3 capacity, then a gradual slowdown after 10:30pm. Comps $184.74 / 4.9% (friends plus some mistakes). Top sellers: Paper Wasp; Rosalie/Native Lion/Long Time Caller (tied). Three no-shows (not charged). Maintenance: under-bar lights cutting in and out more than before. Note: report typed 'Wednesday August 27' but covers Wednesday 8/26 per post time.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 8/26 (MOD: Julian & Saleh)** Just shy of target ($4,872 vs $4,957, -1.7%). Slow start that picked up around sundown and stayed consistent until close with a few stragglers. All sales through Marquee; Standing Room closed. Comps $255.79 — a little of everything (DNL, comps, gifts, discounts). 86'd/low: cucumber, cilantro, tarragon. Favorite moment: getting Jazmin out on time with Xavier rocking the floor.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: On the warmer side but still pleasant
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 8/26 (MOD: Marcus)** Beat target ($3,860 vs $3,329, +16%). Steady evening with a solid start — room nicely filled by 7pm including a 5-top and 6-top. Investor Scott Belanger stopped by for a Royal Port; two locals headed to Melbourne will be connected with Cara at D&C Melbourne; Jordan from The Macallan visited. Walk-ins essentially stopped at 9pm; natural last call at 11:30pm. 90 guests (50 walk-in / 40 resos). Big night for oysters. Comps just $15.80. Maintenance: garbage disposal (United estimate pending); curtain/track at second server station may need replacement.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 8/26 (AM: Braden & Lex / PM: James & Drew)** Well under target ($2,656 vs $5,500, -52%). Quiet morning ($416) — Sam opened solo until 1:30, sent for a break when the 2pm server couldn't come in. Slow, manageable evening ($2,166) — Carla, Kaylee, and Matt handled closing easily; Matt reports better than Monday and Tuesday. Sun Club closed early due to the storm (only 3 at the pool; $74). Hot Eye closed. Kitchen slow with a couple of IRD orders. Guests 34 (8 AM / 26 PM, OpenTable). Favorite moment: cheerful, easy guest interactions all day.
